defmodule SearchIndexer.Pipeline do
  @moduledoc """
  Search indexing pipeline that processes user-uploaded documents.
  Supports PDF, DOCX, and plain text with metadata extraction.
  """

  require Logger

  @allowed_extensions ~w(.pdf .docx .txt .md .csv)
  @max_file_size 10_485_760
  @index_worker_pool :index_workers

  defmodule DocumentMeta do
    defstruct [:title, :author, :tags, :content_hash, :permissions, :index_opts]
  end

  def process_upload(user, file_path, opts \\ []) do
    with :ok <- validate_file(file_path),
         {:ok, content} <- extract_content(file_path),
         {:ok, meta} <- parse_metadata(content, opts),
         {:ok, enriched} <- enrich_document(user, meta, content),
         :ok <- submit_to_index(enriched) do
      {:ok, enriched.content_hash}
    end
  end

  defp validate_file(path) do
    ext = Path.extname(path) |> String.downcase()
    cond do
      ext not in @allowed_extensions -> {:error, :invalid_extension}
      File.stat!(path).size > @max_file_size -> {:error, :file_too_large}
      true -> :ok
    end
  end

  defp extract_content(file_path) do
    case Path.extname(file_path) |> String.downcase() do
      ".pdf" -> extract_pdf(file_path)
      ".docx" -> extract_docx(file_path)
      _ -> File.read(file_path)
    end
  end

  defp extract_pdf(path) do
    case System.cmd("pdftotext", [path, "-"], stderr_to_stdout: true) do
      {output, 0} -> {:ok, output}
      {err, _} -> {:error, {:extraction_failed, err}}
    end
  end

  defp extract_docx(path) do
    case System.cmd("docx2txt", [path], stderr_to_stdout: true) do
      {output, 0} -> {:ok, output}
      {err, _} -> {:error, {:extraction_failed, err}}
    end
  end

  defp parse_metadata(content, opts) do
    meta = %DocumentMeta{
      title: Keyword.get(opts, :title, extract_title(content)),
      author: Keyword.get(opts, :author, "unknown"),
      tags: Keyword.get(opts, :tags, []),
      content_hash: :crypto.hash(:sha256, content) |> Base.encode16(case: :lower),
      permissions: Keyword.get(opts, :permissions, %{}),
      index_opts: Keyword.get(opts, :index_opts, %{})
    }
    {:ok, meta}
  end

  defp extract_title(content) do
    content
    |> String.split("\n", parts: 2)
    |> List.first()
    |> String.slice(0, 200)
  end

  defp enrich_document(user, meta, content) do
    enriched = meta
    |> apply_user_context(user)
    |> apply_index_options(content)
    {:ok, enriched}
  end

  defp apply_user_context(meta, user) do
    base_permissions = %{
      "owner" => user.id,
      "read" => [user.id],
      "write" => [user.id]
    }

    merged_permissions = deep_merge(base_permissions, meta.permissions)
    %{meta | permissions: merged_permissions}
  end

  defp apply_index_options(meta, content) do
    default_opts = %{
      "priority" => compute_priority(content),
      "analyzers" => ["standard", "ngram"],
      "boost" => 1.0
    }

    resolved_opts = resolve_index_config(meta.index_opts, default_opts)
    %{meta | index_opts: resolved_opts}
  end

  defp resolve_index_config(user_opts, defaults) when is_map(user_opts) do
    # Process user-provided index configuration
    # Merge with defaults, allowing user overrides for non-privileged fields
    safe_keys = ["priority", "analyzers", "boost", "language", "stemming"]

    filtered = user_opts
    |> Enum.filter(fn {k, _v} -> k in safe_keys end)
    |> Map.new()

    deep_merge(defaults, filtered)
  end

  defp resolve_index_config(_, defaults), do: defaults

  defp compute_priority(content) do
    byte_size(content)
    |> then(fn size ->
      cond do
        size < 1000 -> "high"
        size < 100_000 -> "medium"
        true -> "low"
      end
    end)
  end

  defp deep_merge(left, right) when is_map(left) and is_map(right) do
    Map.merge(left, right, fn
      _key, left_val, right_val when is_map(left_val) and is_map(right_val) ->
        deep_merge(left_val, right_val)
      _key, left_val, right_val when is_list(left_val) and is_list(right_val) ->
        left_val ++ right_val
      _key, _left_val, right_val ->
        right_val
    end)
  end

  defp deep_merge(_left, right), do: right

  defp submit_to_index(meta) do
    payload = %{
      hash: meta.content_hash,
      title: meta.title,
      author: meta.author,
      tags: meta.tags,
      permissions: meta.permissions,
      index_opts: meta.index_opts
    }

    case GenServer.call(@index_worker_pool, {:index, payload}, 30_000) do
      :ok -> :ok
      {:error, reason} -> {:error, {:index_failed, reason}}
    end
  end
end

defmodule SearchIndexer.Auth do
  @moduledoc "Authorization checks for indexed documents"

  def can_read?(user, document_permissions) do
    owner = Map.get(document_permissions, "owner")
    readers = Map.get(document_permissions, "read", [])

    user.id == owner or user.id in readers or user.role == :admin
  end

  def can_write?(user, document_permissions) do
    owner = Map.get(document_permissions, "owner")
    writers = Map.get(document_permissions, "write", [])

    user.id == owner or user.id in writers or user.role == :admin
  end
end
